reviewScope: SurfaceV2 actual packed game GLB and independent high source inspected against the recovered 3275x2399 primary 2007 photograph and four new same-car reference views, including paint, cast tread/contact abrasion and rear oxide close-ups under two light profiles. MaterialV1 was rejected by the user. Camera fits and channel checks are not used as proof of surface fidelity. See Data_MaterialReview.json for the visual evidence and declared limits; user approval is not implied.
selectedConfiguration: Type89 I-Go Otsu, restored running vehicle at JGSDF Tsuchiura. Primary appearance state is the 2007 Megapixie photograph; 2025 Hunini views corroborate the same preserved car's closed hatches and geometry. Early Ko nose/cupola features are excluded.

dimensionEvidence.adopted: Japanese Type89 summary separates Ko5.75m/Otsu5.70m and gives width2.18m/height2.56m. Independent summaries give5.73m and width2.15-2.18m. The reconstruction records that uncertainty rather than inheriting the legacy game's4.30m normalization.
dimensionEvidence.primarySourceLimit: The referenced original naval equipment table is a lead, not an opened primary measurement: the supplied public JACAR PDF paths returned404. The American1944 handbook calls the later vehicle Model94 and estimates23ft including ditching tail, which conflicts with later summaries; that estimate was not blended into the adopted envelope.
dimensionEvidence.detailDimensions: Wheel stations, panel contours, small fittings and pivots are calibrated from photographs within the nominal envelope. They are reconstruction measurements, not claimed factory dimensions.

sourceAxes: Blender X right, +Y nose, +Z up; metres; ground datum under hull center
runtimeAxes: glTF X right, +Y up, -Z nose; metres; measured vertex cloud and bore direction are validated

surfaceContract.channels: sRGB Base; linear OpenGL tangent Normal; linear ORM R=AO,G=roughness,B=metallic
surfaceContract.shadowMaterial: constant dark dielectric cavity, no invented interior machinery
surfaceContract.method: Reference-calibrated metre-scaled coating, abrasion, oxide and dirt masks with independent Base/Normal/ORM; SurfaceV2 full bake plus verified Base-only pigment adjustment

inferred: Original1938 paint cannot be established from a restored2007/2025 museum finish. The chosen hue describes photographic restoration appearance, not a factory paint specification.
Hidden engine/turret interiors are dark simplified recesses. Bracket backs, concealed fasteners and small hinge construction not resolved in photographs remain reconstruction.
Contact-band composition is not proven by the available pictures; the dark matte band is a declared material inference.
Micro paint texture, oxide pits and settled dust are physically zoned authoring details calibrated to visible condition, not measured historical damage.
Internal guide depth and wheel running clearance were refined against actual re-imported triangle motion. They are functional visual reconstruction rather than manufacturing dimensions.
The primary 2007 original was recovered during material review (3275x2399). Some other Commons originals remain unavailable and their explicitly labeled standard 1280px thumbnails are retained.
historicalBoundary: Museum/same-type appearance references do not establish participation in the16-18March Tengxian city assault. This independent asset does not replace the legacy Type89Tank or change mission history.
